notes:
Lead profile: SMB, B2B SaaS — building a lightweight customer support chat + knowledge search. Self-serve signup on 2026-02-18; started POC quickly. Primary technical contact: CTO Emma Liu (emma@botmetrics.co). AE Jordan initial outreach; SE Priya doing technical deep-dive.

Observed problem: during POC we see periodic 429s when onboarding campaigns fire (new-user welcome sequence triggers 300-500 simultaneous generation calls). They do short-lived spikes (30s-3m) rather than steady high QPS. Customer quote: "We only spike when an onboarding cohort hits — it overwhelms the demo key. Need a reliable way to survive bursts without complex infra."

Requirements summary:
- Workload: in-app chat (real-time), embeddings for KB search, occasional reranking of top-N results.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 350ms for chat; embeddings async ok (few seconds).
- Throughput: baseline ~40 reqs/min, bursts up to ~500 reqs/min for short windows. Expect occasional concurrency spikes of 50-200 depending on campaign.
- Cost sensitivity: high — SMB budget, wants predictable per-token costs and guardrails to avoid runaway bills.
- Model prefs: prefer open-size family, ok with Redwood catalog suggestions.
- Routing/fallback: would like automatic fallback to cheaper model during high load OR clear guidance for client side throttling.
- Security: hosted API acceptable if SOC2 attestation and SSO for admin console; audit logs required for basic compliance.

Technical notes from SE call:
- They tested with default trial limits and hit burst concurrency cap -> got 429s with Retry-After ~5s.
- No circuit-breaker in client currently; retries were naive exponential without jitter leading to retry storms.
- Asked for: recommended Retry-After handling, recommended concurrency window per API key, sample client-side token bucket algorithm, and a path to request temporary burst increase for POC.

Proposed approach (agreed on call):
- Provide a short doc: "Hosted API burst handling for SMBs" with examples (token-bucket, leaky-bucket, exponential backoff + jitter), and sample JS/Python snippets.
- Offer a 30-day temporary quota bump for POC tied to usage caps and alerting.
- Suggest Redwood Optimize presets for batching + prefix caching to reduce token use on embeddings/QA flows.
- Next SE action: run a short synthetic load to reproduce 429s and capture headers (X-RateLimit-* and Retry-After) to tune recommended client logic.
